pages.title: Copper Ore
pages.text: Cooper Ore is smelted into copper ingots, used to craft basic wires, coils, and other important pieces

pages.title: Aluminum Ore
pages.text: Aluminum Ore is smelted into aluminium ingots which, when used with steel, create high-voltage wires

pages.title: Lead Ore
pages.text: Lead Ore is smelted into lead ingots which are used to create capacitors

pages.title: Silver Ore
pages.text: Silver Ore is smelted into silver ingots which alloy with gold to form electrum, a effective conductor

pages.title: Nickel Ore
pages.text: Nickel Ore is smelted into nickel ingots which alloy with copper to form constantan, a head resistant conductor

pages.title: Uranium Ore
pages.text: Uranium Ore is smelted into uranium ingots, but there is not many uses for it
